exercises.explanationUz:
UNIT NOMI: 'All's Well that Ends Well'
  = Oxiri yaxshi bo'lsa, hammasi yaxshi.
  Bu — Shekspir pyesasining nomi, ingliz maqoliga aylangan.
  Ma'nosi: qiyinchiliklar bo'lsa ham, natija yaxshi bo'lsa,
  hammasi joyida.

OLTI RASM — HIKOYA KETMA-KETLIGI:

  A  Safari parkda mashina sherlar orasida qolgan.
     Sherlar mashinani o'rab olgan, qo'rqinchli ko'rinadi.

  B  Mashina ichida. Dvigateldan TUTUN chiqyapti.
     Ikkalasi ham xavotirda.

  C  Mashinaning oldi YONYAPTI. Ikkalasi dahshatda.

  D  Mashina yonmoqda, yonida boshqa avtomobil,
     sherlar hali ham atrofda.

  E  Odamlar yonayotgan mashinadan 'Safari Park'
     yozuvli jipga yugurib ketishyapti.

  F  Er-xotin quchoqlashgan — qutulishdi, xursand.

QAHRAMONLAR:
  CLAIRE (Kler) — sariq sochli ayol
  GREG (Greg)   — sariq sochli erkak
  PARK RANGER   — parkni qo'riqlovchi xodim

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a safari park = safari park (hayvonlar erkin yuradigan bog')
  a park ranger = park qo'riqchisi, bog' xodimi
  an engine     = dvigatel
  smoke         = tutun
  on fire       = yonayotgan
  scary         = qo'rqinchli
  a jeep        = jip

tasks.en: Look at the pictures.
tasks.uz: Rasmlarga qarang.

tasks.en: A — The car is in a safari park, surrounded by lions.
tasks.uz: A — Mashina safari parkda, sherlar o'rab olgan.
tasks.note:
'a safari park' = hayvonlar erkin yuradigan bog'.
Mashinadan chiqmaslik kerak.

tasks.en: B — Smoke is coming out of the engine.
tasks.uz: B — Dvigateldan tutun chiqyapti.
tasks.note:
'smoke' = tutun (sanalmaydigan).
'an engine' = dvigatel.

tasks.en: C — The front of the car is on fire.
tasks.uz: C — Mashinaning old qismi yonyapti.
tasks.note:
'on fire' = yonayotgan.
'the front of the car' = mashinaning old qismi.

tasks.en: D — The car is burning and the lions are still around.
tasks.uz: D — Mashina yonmoqda, sherlar hali ham atrofda.
tasks.note:
'to burn' = yonmoq.
'around' = atrofida.

tasks.en: E — They are running from the car to the Safari Park jeep.
tasks.uz: E — Ular mashinadan Safari Park jipiga yugurishyapti.
tasks.note:
'to run TOWARDS' = ...tomon yugurmoq.
Jipda 'Safari Park' yozuvi bor.

tasks.en: F — They are safe. They are shocked but happy.
tasks.uz: F — Ular xavfsiz. Hayratda, lekin xursand.
tasks.note:
'safe' = xavfsiz.
'shocked' = hayratda, sarosimada.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures, then read the questions and circle the correct answer.
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlarga qarang, so'ng savollarni o'qib to'g'ri javobni belgilang.
exercises.explanationUz:
Javoblar RASMLARDAN topiladi — matnni o'qish shart emas.

USUL: har bir savolda qaysi RASM aytilganini toping,
so'ng o'sha rasmga qarang.

tasks.prompt: 1  Where are the two people in picture A?
tasks.whyUz:
A-rasmda SHERLAR erkin yuribdi → SAFARI PARK.
'an aquarium' = akvarium (baliqlar uchun) — mos emas.
Hikoyada joy nomi ham bor: Longleat Safari Park.

tasks.prompt: 2  How do the lions look in picture A?
tasks.whyUz:
Sherlar mashinani o'rab olgan, tishlari ko'rinadi →
QO'RQINChLI.
'scary' = qo'rqinchli;  'friendly' = do'stona.
77-betdagi matnda ham: 'very SCARY animals'.

tasks.prompt: 3  What is coming out of the engine in picture B?
tasks.whyUz:
B-rasmda dvigateldan kulrang TUTUN chiqyapti — hali olov emas.
Olov keyingi rasmda (C) paydo bo'ladi.
77-betdagi matnda: 'SMOKE began to come out of the engine'.

tasks.prompt: 4  What's wrong with the front of the car in picture C?
options: b There's a lion on it.
tasks.whyUz:
C-rasmda mashinaning oldi YONYAPTI.
77-betdagi matnda: 'the front of the car was ON FIRE'.
'What's wrong with ...?' = ...da nima yomon?

tasks.prompt: 5  What does a park ranger do?
tasks.answer: a He looks after a park.
options: a He looks after a park.
tasks.whyUz:
'a park ranger' = bog'ni QO'RIQLAYDIGAN va PARVARISH
qiladigan xodim.
'look after' = qaramoq, parvarish qilmoq.
'put out fires' = o't o'chirmoq — bu o't o'chiruvchining ishi
('a firefighter').

tasks.prompt: 6  How do the people feel in picture C?
tasks.whyUz:
Mashina yonyapti, chiqib bo'lmaydi → QO'RQQAN.
'scared' = qo'rqqan.
77-betdagi matnda: 'They were both really SCARED'.

tasks.prompt: 7  How do they feel in picture F?
tasks.whyUz:
F-rasmda quchoqlashgan va jilmayishyapti — qutulishdi.
Lekin hali sarosimadalar.
77-betdagi matnda: 'They were still SHOCKED, but HAPPY'.
Unit nomiga mos: 'All's Well that Ends Well'.

exercises.instructionEn: Study the list of events below. Then, listen to the sounds and number the events in the order you hear them in the boxes provided.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi voqealar ro'yxatini o'rganing. So'ng tovushlarni tinglang va voqealarni eshitgan tartibingizda raqamlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
Bu mashqda TOVUSHLAR tinglanadi:
  kulgi, fotoapparat, sher bo'kirishi, dvigatel ovozi,
  signal va qichqiriq, jip ovozi, yugurish qadamlari.

TARTIB 77-BETDAGI HIKOYADA ANIQ YOZILGAN —
shuning uchun bu yerda to'liq berildi.

TO'G'RI TARTIB:

  1  Claire laughed.                           (KITOBDA berilgan)
  2  He stopped the car and started taking
     pictures of the lions.
  3  The lions roared loudly.
  4  He tried to start the car several times.
  5  She beeped the horn and shouted for help.
  6  Just then, a park ranger came along the
     road in his jeep.
  7  They jumped out of the car quickly and
     ran to the jeep.

HIKOYADAGI KETMA-KETLIK (77-bet):
  '... Claire LAUGHED. Soon, they saw some lions.
   Greg STOPPED the car ... and started TAKING PICTURES.
   The lions ROARED loudly. ...
   He TRIED TO START the car several times ...
   She BEEPED THE HORN and shouted for help.
   Just then, a park ranger CAME ALONG the road in his jeep.
   ... Claire and Greg JUMPED OUT of the car quickly and
   RAN TOWARDS the jeep.'

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to roar      = bo'kirmoq (sher haqida)
  to beep the horn = signal chalmoq
  a horn       = signal (mashinada)
  to jump out of = ...dan sakrab chiqmoq
  along        = bo'ylab
  just then    = shu payt

tasks.prompt: He stopped the car and started taking pictures of the lions.
tasks.whyUz:
IKKINCHI voqea.
Matnda: 'Greg STOPPED the car very close to the lions and
STARTED TAKING PICTURES of them.'
A-rasmga mos keladi.
tasks.speak: He stopped the car and started taking pictures of the lions.

tasks.whyUz:
UCHINCHI voqea.
Matnda: 'The lions ROARED loudly.'
'to roar' = bo'kirmoq.

tasks.prompt: He tried to start the car several times.
tasks.whyUz:
TO'RTINCHI voqea.
Matnda: 'He TRIED TO START the car several times, but
nothing happened.'
Mashina yurmadi — muammo shu yerdan boshlandi.
'several times' = bir necha marta.
tasks.speak: He tried to start the car several times.

tasks.prompt: She beeped the horn and shouted for help.
tasks.whyUz:
BESHINCHI voqea.
Matnda: 'She BEEPED THE HORN and SHOUTED FOR HELP.'
C-rasmga mos keladi.
'shout FOR help' = yordam so'rab qichqirmoq.
tasks.speak: She beeped the horn and shouted for help.

tasks.prompt: Just then, a park ranger came along the road in his jeep.
tasks.whyUz:
OLTINCHI voqea.
Matnda: 'JUST THEN, a park ranger CAME ALONG the road in
his jeep.'
'just then' = shu payt (kutilmaganda).
tasks.speak: Just then, a park ranger came along the road in his jeep.

tasks.prompt: They jumped out of the car quickly and ran to the jeep.
tasks.whyUz:
YETTINChI voqea.
Matnda: 'Claire and Greg JUMPED OUT of the car quickly and
RAN TOWARDS the jeep.'
E-rasmga mos keladi.
DIQQAT: matnda 'ran TOWARDS', mashqda 'ran TO' —
ikkalasi ham to'g'ri.
tasks.speak: They jumped out of the car quickly and ran to the jeep.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the sentences, then listen to the story and write who said what. Write C for Claire, G for Greg or P for the park ranger.
exercises.instructionUz: Gaplarni o'qing, so'ng hikoyani tinglab kim nima aytganini yozing. Kler uchun C, Greg uchun G, park qo'riqchisi uchun P deb yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
UCH QAHRAMON:
  C = CLAIRE (Kler) — ayol
  G = GREG (Greg) — erkak
  P = PARK RANGER (park qo'riqchisi)

Javoblar 77-betdagi hikoya matnida ANIQ yozilgan —
har bir gapdan keyin kim aytgani ko'rsatilgan.

USUL — ISM CHAQIRILSA, BOSHQASI AYTADI:
  "You're right, CLAIRE ..." → GREG aytdi

MANTIQ ham yordam beradi:
  Qutqaruvchi gap ('we'll get you out') → RANGER
  Qo'rquv gaplari → CLAIRE (u ko'proq qo'rqadi)

tasks.prompt: a  "We don't want to be a lion's lunch."
tasks.whyUz:
CLAIRE.
Matnda: "'We don't want to be a lion's lunch,'
CLAIRE LAUGHED."
2-mashqning 1-bandi ham shu gapga asoslanadi.
"a lion's LUNCH" = sherning tushligi — hazil.
'lion'S' — egalik apostrofi.

tasks.prompt: b  "They're beautiful, but very scary animals."
tasks.whyUz:
CLAIRE.
Matnda: "'They're beautiful, but very scary animals,'
CLAIRE SAID."
Keyingi gapda Greg 'You're right, CLAIRE' deydi —
bu ham tasdiqlaydi.

tasks.prompt: c  "Let's go and see the gorillas, now."
tasks.whyUz:
GREG.
Matnda: "'You're right, Claire. Let's go and see the
gorillas, now,' GREG SAID."
DIQQAT: gapda 'Claire' CHAQIRILGAN → demak BOShQASI
(Greg) aytdi.
'a gorilla' = gorilla.

CLAIRE.
Matnda: "'We'll burn alive!' CLAIRE SCREAMED desperately."
'to burn alive' = tiriklayin yonmoq.
'desperately' = umidsizlik bilan, jon holatda.
'we'll' = we WILL — kelasi zamon bashorati (69-betdagi qoida).

tasks.prompt: e  "Hold on, we'll get you out!"
tasks.whyUz:
PARK RANGER.
Matnda: "'Hold on, we'll get you out!' HE SHOUTED" —
'he' = oldingi gapda aytilgan park ranger.
'Hold on!' = chidang! kuting!
'get somebody out' = kimnidir chiqarib olmoq.

exercises.instructionEn: Write the past simple tense of these verbs.
exercises.instructionUz: Bu fe'llarning oddiy o'tgan zamon shaklini yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
O'N IKKI FE'L — hammasi hikoyada uchraydi.

TO'G'RI FE'LLAR (5 ta):
  close → closed    (oxiri -E → + D)
  stop  → stopped   (undosh IKKILANADI)
  chase → chased    (oxiri -E → + D)
  start → started   (oddiy + ED)
  roar  → roared    (oddiy + ED)
  try   → tried     (undosh + Y → IED)
  jump  → jumped    (oddiy + ED)

NOTO'G'RI FE'LLAR (5 ta):
  go    → went
  come  → came
  see   → saw
  know  → knew
  begin → began

DIQQAT — 'STOP' va 'TRY':
  stop → stoPPed  (bir bo'g'inli, urg'uli unli → P ikkilanadi)
  try  → trIED    ('r' undosh + 'y' → -IED)

tasks.whyUz:
go → WENT.
Matnda: 'Claire and Greg WENT to Longleat Safari Park'.

close → closed (to'g'ri fe'l).
Matnda: 'they CLOSED the car windows tightly'.

come → CAME.
Matnda: 'a park ranger CAME along the road'.
'become → became' bilan bir xil naqsh.

see → SAW, o'qilishi /sɔː/.
Matnda: 'they SAW some lions'.
DIQQAT: 'seed' XATO.

stop → stoPPed.
Bir bo'g'inli, oxiri UNDOSH+UNLI+UNDOSH → 'p' ikkilanadi.
Matnda: 'Greg STOPPED the car'.

chase → chased (to'g'ri fe'l).
Matnda: 'another jeep arrived and CHASED AWAY the lions'.

start → started.
-ed /ɪd/ deb o'qiladi (oxiri 't').
Matnda: 'STARTED taking pictures'.

roar → roared.
Matnda: 'The lions ROARED loudly'.

know → KNEW.
DIQQAT: boshidagi 'k' O'QILMAYDI — /njuː/.
Matnda: 'They KNEW they were very lucky'.

try → TRIED ('r' undosh + 'y' → -IED).
Matnda: 'He TRIED to start the car'.

begin → BEGAN.
Matnda: 'smoke BEGAN to come out of the engine'.
'sing → sang' bilan bir xil naqsh.

jump → jumped.
Matnda: 'Claire and Greg JUMPED OUT of the car'.

exercises.instructionEn: Choose words from the list to fill in the gaps, then use them to make sentences.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdan so'z tanlab bo'shliqlarni to'ldiring, so'ng ular bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (9 ta so'z, 9 ta bo'shliq):
  beeped, burn, roared, tightly, park, lucky, chased,
  screamed, scary

Har biri AYNAN BIR MARTA ishlatiladi.
Barcha iboralar 77-betdagi hikoyadan olingan.

QANDAY TANLANADI:
  bo'shliqdan KEYIN ot bo'lsa → SIFAT yoki aniqlovchi
     ...... ranger  → park
     ...... animals → scary
  bo'shliqdan KEYIN ravish bo'lsa → FE'L
     ...... loudly     → roared
     ...... desperately → screamed

tasks.whyUz:
'closed the windows TIGHTLY' = oynalarni mahkam yopdi.
'tight' (mahkam) + -ly → RAVISH.
Gap: When they drove into the park, they closed the car
windows tightly.

'ROARED loudly' = baland ovozda bo'kirdi.
'loudly' — ravish, fe'lga tegishli.
Gap: The lions roared loudly.

'BEEPED the horn' = signal chaldi.
Gap: She beeped the horn and shouted for help.

'SCREAMED desperately' = jon holatda qichqirdi.
'to scream' = chinqirmoq (qo'rquvdan).
Gap: "We'll burn alive!" Claire screamed desperately.

'BURN alive' = tiriklayin yonmoq.
DIQQAT: bu yerda fe'l ASOSIY shaklda —
chunki 'we'll' dan keyin keladi.
Gap: We'll burn alive!

'PARK ranger' = park qo'riqchisi.
'park' bu yerda OT sifatida boshqa otni aniqlaydi
(qo'shma ot).
Gap: A park ranger came along the road in his jeep.

'SCARY animals' = qo'rqinchli hayvonlar.
DIQQAT: 'scary' (narsa qo'rqinchli) ↔ 'scared' (odam qo'rqqan).
Gap: They're beautiful, but very scary animals.

'CHASED AWAY the lions' = sherlarni quvib yubordi.
'chase away' — frazali fe'l.
Gap: Another jeep arrived and chased away the lions.

tasks.promptUz: Tirik qolganlari uchun qanday his qilishdi?
tasks.whyUz:
'LUCKY to be alive' = tirik qolgani uchun omadli.
'lucky' = omadli;  'luck' = omad.
Gap: They knew they were very lucky to be alive.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the correct prepositions from the list.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT: around, towards, on, in, into, out of, for, along

8 ta predlog, 9 ta bo'shliq — demak bittasi
IKKI MARTA ishlatiladi:
  'for' → 2 marta (shouted FOR help, thanked him FOR his help)

Hamma ibora 77-betdagi hikoyadan olingan.

ENG MUHIM JUFTLIK — 'IN' va 'INTO':
  INTO — HARAKAT, ichkariga kirish
     they drove INTO the park  (tashqaridan ichkariga)
  IN   — JOY, ichida bo'lish
     he came in his jeep       (jip ichida edi)

ENG MUHIM JUFTLIK — 'TO' va 'TOWARDS':
  TO      — maqsad, yetib borish
  TOWARDS — YO'NALISh, ...tomon
     they ran TOWARDS the jeep  (jip tomon)

tasks.whyUz:
'drove INTO the park' = parkka haydab kirdi.
INTO — ichkariga HARAKAT.
DIQQAT: 'in the park' bo'lsa — parkning ICHIDA bo'lish
(harakat emas).

'ON fire' = yonayotgan — o'zgarmas ibora.
'in fire' XATO.

'jump OUT OF the car' = mashinadan sakrab chiqmoq.
IKKI so'zdan iborat predlog.
'INTO' ning aksi:
  jump INTO the car   (ichkariga)
  jump OUT OF the car (tashqariga)

'AROUND it' = uning atrofida.
Shuning uchun chiqib bo'lmasdi.

'shout FOR help' = yordam so'rab qichqirmoq.
'for' — MAQSAD bildiradi.
8-band bilan solishtiring — 'for' u yerda ham bor.

tasks.prompt: 6  he came ............ the road ............ his jeep  [1-bo'shliq]
tasks.whyUz:
'come ALONG the road' = yo'l bo'ylab kelmoq.
'along' = bo'ylab (uzunasiga).
tasks.speak: 6  he came ............ the road ............ his jeep  [1-bo'shliq]

tasks.whyUz:
'IN his jeep' = jipida (ichida o'tirgan).
DIQQAT — TRANSPORT PREDLOGLARI:
  BY car/jeep  — umumiy usul ('by jeep')
  IN a car/jeep — aniq mashina ichida
  ON a bus/train — katta transportda

'run TOWARDS the jeep' = jip tomon yugurmoq.
'towards' = ...tomon (YO'NALISh).
DIQQAT: 'to' ham to'g'ri, lekin 'towards' harakat
yo'nalishini kuchliroq ta'kidlaydi.

'thank somebody FOR something' = ...uchun rahmat aytmoq.
'for' SHART.
5-band bilan bir xil predlog — ro'yxatda 8 ta so'z,
9 ta bo'shliq bo'lgani uchun 'for' ikki marta.

sections.title: Reading — the Longleat Safari Park story

exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ MATN:

  One gorgeous, sunny day last summer, Claire and her
  friend Greg went to Longleat Safari Park.

  When they drove into the park, they closed the car
  windows tightly. "We don't want to be a lion's lunch,"
  Claire laughed. Soon, they saw some lions. Greg stopped
  the car very close to the lions and started taking
  pictures of them. The lions roared loudly. "They're
  beautiful, but very scary animals," Claire said. "You're
  right, Claire. Let's go and see the gorillas, now," Greg
  said. He tried to start the car several times, but
  nothing happened. Suddenly, smoke began to come out of
  the engine.

  A few minutes later, the front of the car was on fire.
  They wanted to jump out of the car, but they couldn't
  because the lions were around it. They were both really
  scared. "We'll burn alive!" Claire screamed desperately.
  She beeped the horn and shouted for help. Just then, a
  park ranger came along the road in his jeep. "Hold on,
  we'll get you out!" he shouted. Almost immediately,
  another jeep arrived and chased away the lions. Claire
  and Greg jumped out of the car quickly and ran towards
  the jeep.

  When they were safe inside the jeep, they thanked the
  park ranger for his help. They were still shocked, but
  happy. They knew they were very lucky to be alive.


O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:

  O'tgan yozning ajoyib, quyoshli kunlaridan birida Kler
  va uning do'sti Greg Longleat safari parkiga borishdi.

  Parkka kirganlarida mashina oynalarini mahkam yopishdi.
  "Sherning tushligi bo'lishni xohlamaymiz," — deb kuldi
  Kler. Tez orada ular bir necha sherni ko'rishdi. Greg
  mashinani sherlarga juda yaqin to'xtatdi va ularni
  suratga ola boshladi. Sherlar baland ovozda bo'kirishdi.
  "Ular go'zal, lekin juda qo'rqinchli hayvonlar," — dedi
  Kler. "To'g'ri aytasan, Kler. Endi gorillalarni ko'rgani
  boraylik," — dedi Greg. U mashinani bir necha marta
  yurgizmoqchi bo'ldi, lekin hech narsa bo'lmadi.
  To'satdan dvigateldan tutun chiqa boshladi.

  Bir necha daqiqadan keyin mashinaning old qismi yona
  boshladi. Ular mashinadan sakrab chiqmoqchi bo'lishdi,
  lekin chiqolmadilar, chunki sherlar atrofda edi. Ikkalasi
  ham juda qo'rqib ketishdi. "Tiriklayin yonamiz!" — deb
  jon holatda qichqirdi Kler. U signal chaldi va yordam
  so'rab qichqirdi. Shu payt yo'l bo'ylab jipda park
  qo'riqchisi keldi. "Chidang, sizni chiqarib olamiz!" —
  deb qichqirdi u. Deyarli darhol yana bir jip yetib keldi
  va sherlarni quvib yubordi. Kler va Greg mashinadan tez
  sakrab chiqib, jip tomon yugurishdi.

  Jip ichida xavfsiz bo'lganlarida ular park qo'riqchisiga
  yordami uchun rahmat aytishdi. Ular hali ham sarosimada
  edi, lekin xursand edi. Tirik qolganlari uchun juda
  omadli ekanlarini bilishardi.


MATN TUZILISHI (4 xatboshi):
  1  KIRISH — qachon, qayerda, kim
  2  BOSHLANISH — parkka kirish, sherlar, mashina buzildi
  3  TUGUN — yong'in, qo'rquv, qutqaruv
  4  YECHIM — xavfsizlik, minnatdorchilik, his-tuyg'u

BU — HIKOYA YOZISH NAMUNASI.
Unitning oxirida shunday hikoya yozish o'rgatiladi.

DIQQAT — HIKOYA O'TGAN ZAMONDA:
  went, drove, closed, laughed, saw, stopped, started,
  roared, said, tried, began, was, wanted, couldn't, were,
  screamed, beeped, shouted, came, arrived, chased,
  jumped, ran, thanked, knew

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  gorgeous     = ajoyib, go'zal
  tightly      = mahkam
  close to     = ...ga yaqin
  several times = bir necha marta
  nothing happened = hech narsa bo'lmadi
  suddenly     = to'satdan
  a few minutes later = bir necha daqiqadan keyin
  desperately  = jon holatda
  almost immediately = deyarli darhol
  to chase away = quvib yubormoq
  safe         = xavfsiz
  to thank somebody FOR = ...uchun rahmat aytmoq
  lucky        = omadli
  alive        = tirik

tasks.en: Read the story.
tasks.uz: Hikoyani o'qing.

tasks.en: One gorgeous, sunny day last summer, Claire and her friend Greg went to Longleat Safari Park.
tasks.uz: O'tgan yozning ajoyib, quyoshli kunlaridan birida Kler va do'sti Greg Longleat safari parkiga borishdi.
tasks.note:
HIKOYANING KIRISH gapi — QAChON, KIM, QAYERGA.
'gorgeous' = ajoyib, go'zal.
'One ... day' = kunlardan birida — hikoya boshlash qolipi.

tasks.en: When they drove into the park, they closed the car windows tightly.
tasks.uz: Parkka kirganlarida mashina oynalarini mahkam yopishdi.
tasks.note:
drive → DROVE (noto'g'ri fe'l).
'drive INTO' = ichkariga haydab kirmoq.
'tightly' = mahkam (tight + -ly).

tasks.en: "We don't want to be a lion's lunch," Claire laughed.
tasks.uz: "Sherning tushligi bo'lishni xohlamaymiz," — deb kuldi Kler.
tasks.note:
76-betdagi 3-mashqning a-bandi.
"a lion'S lunch" — egalik apostrofi.
Hazil bilan aytilgan.

tasks.en: Greg stopped the car very close to the lions and started taking pictures of them.
tasks.uz: Greg mashinani sherlarga juda yaqin to'xtatdi va ularni suratga ola boshladi.
tasks.note:
'close TO' = ...ga yaqin.
'start + fe'l-ing' = ...ni boshlamoq.
'take pictures OF' = ...ni suratga olmoq.

tasks.en: The lions roared loudly.
tasks.uz: Sherlar baland ovozda bo'kirishdi.
tasks.note:
'to roar' = bo'kirmoq.
'loudly' = baland ovozda (loud + -ly).

tasks.en: "They're beautiful, but very scary animals," Claire said.
tasks.uz: "Ular go'zal, lekin juda qo'rqinchli hayvonlar," — dedi Kler.
tasks.note:
76-betdagi 3-mashqning b-bandi.
'but' — qarama-qarshilik: go'zal, LEKIN qo'rqinchli.

tasks.en: "You're right, Claire. Let's go and see the gorillas, now," Greg said.
tasks.uz: "To'g'ri aytasan, Kler. Endi gorillalarni ko'rgani boraylik," — dedi Greg.
tasks.note:
76-betdagi 3-mashqning c-bandi.
DIQQAT: gapda 'Claire' CHAQIRILGAN → GREG aytdi.
'Let's go AND see' — ikki fe'l 'and' bilan.

tasks.en: He tried to start the car several times, but nothing happened.
tasks.uz: U mashinani bir necha marta yurgizmoqchi bo'ldi, lekin hech narsa bo'lmadi.
tasks.note:
'try TO + fe'l' = ...qilishga urinmoq.
'several times' = bir necha marta.
'nothing happened' = hech narsa bo'lmadi — muammoning boshi.

tasks.en: Suddenly, smoke began to come out of the engine.
tasks.uz: To'satdan dvigateldan tutun chiqa boshladi.
tasks.note:
'Suddenly' = to'satdan — hikoyada burilish nuqtasini bildiradi.
begin → BEGAN (noto'g'ri fe'l).
'come out of' = ...dan chiqmoq.
76-betdagi B-rasmga mos keladi.

tasks.en: A few minutes later, the front of the car was on fire.
tasks.uz: Bir necha daqiqadan keyin mashinaning old qismi yona boshladi.
tasks.note:
'a few minutes later' = bir necha daqiqadan keyin —
vaqt o'tganini bildiradi.
'on fire' = yonayotgan.
76-betdagi C-rasmga mos keladi.

tasks.en: They wanted to jump out of the car, but they couldn't because the lions were around it.
tasks.uz: Ular mashinadan sakrab chiqmoqchi bo'lishdi, lekin chiqolmadilar, chunki sherlar atrofda edi.
tasks.note:
'want TO + fe'l';  'jump OUT OF' = ...dan sakrab chiqmoq.
'couldn't' — 9-unitdagi 'could' ning inkori.
'because' — sabab bog'lovchisi.

tasks.en: "We'll burn alive!" Claire screamed desperately.
tasks.uz: "Tiriklayin yonamiz!" — deb jon holatda qichqirdi Kler.
tasks.note:
76-betdagi 3-mashqning d-bandi.
'we'll' = we WILL — bashorat (69-betdagi qoida).
'to burn alive' = tiriklayin yonmoq.
'desperately' = jon holatda, umidsizlik bilan.

tasks.en: She beeped the horn and shouted for help.
tasks.uz: U signal chaldi va yordam so'rab qichqirdi.
tasks.note:
'beep the horn' = signal chalmoq.
'shout FOR help' = yordam so'rab qichqirmoq — 'for' shart.

tasks.en: Just then, a park ranger came along the road in his jeep.
tasks.uz: Shu payt yo'l bo'ylab jipda park qo'riqchisi keldi.
tasks.note:
'Just then' = shu payt — kutilmagan yordam.
'come ALONG the road' = yo'l bo'ylab kelmoq.
'IN his jeep' — mashina ichida bo'lsa IN.

tasks.en: "Hold on, we'll get you out!" he shouted.
tasks.uz: "Chidang, sizni chiqarib olamiz!" — deb qichqirdi u.
tasks.note:
76-betdagi 3-mashqning e-bandi — PARK RANGER aytdi.
'Hold on!' = chidang! kuting!
'get somebody out' = kimnidir chiqarib olmoq.

tasks.en: Almost immediately, another jeep arrived and chased away the lions.
tasks.uz: Deyarli darhol yana bir jip yetib keldi va sherlarni quvib yubordi.
tasks.note:
'almost immediately' = deyarli darhol.
'another' = yana bir.
'chase away' = quvib yubormoq.

tasks.en: Claire and Greg jumped out of the car quickly and ran towards the jeep.
tasks.uz: Kler va Greg mashinadan tez sakrab chiqib, jip tomon yugurishdi.
tasks.note:
run → RAN (noto'g'ri fe'l).
'TOWARDS the jeep' = jip TOMON.
76-betdagi E-rasmga mos keladi.

tasks.en: When they were safe inside the jeep, they thanked the park ranger for his help.
tasks.uz: Jip ichida xavfsiz bo'lganlarida ular park qo'riqchisiga yordami uchun rahmat aytishdi.
tasks.note:
'safe' = xavfsiz.
'thank somebody FOR something' = ...uchun rahmat aytmoq —
'for' SHART.

tasks.en: They were still shocked, but happy. They knew they were very lucky to be alive.
tasks.uz: Ular hali ham sarosimada edi, lekin xursand edi. Tirik qolganlari uchun juda omadli ekanlarini bilishardi.
tasks.note:
HIKOYANING YAKUNI — his-tuyg'u bilan tugaydi.
know → KNEW (noto'g'ri fe'l).
'lucky TO BE alive' = tirik qolgani uchun omadli.
76-betdagi F-rasmga va unit nomiga mos:
'All's Well that Ends Well'.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the story and answer the questions.
exercises.instructionUz: Hikoyani o'qing va savollarga javob bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
Yetti savol — hikoyaning ASOSIY qismlarini tekshiradi:
  joy va vaqt, ob-havo, qahramonlar, voqea, qutqaruvchi,
  his-tuyg'u, asosiy voqea.

BU SAVOLLAR HIKOYA YOZISH REJASI HAMDIR:
  har bir hikoyada shu ma'lumotlar bo'lishi kerak.

tasks.prompt: 1  Where and when did the story take place?
tasks.answer: It took place at Longleat Safari Park, one gorgeous, sunny day last summer.
tasks.whyUz:
Matnda: 'One gorgeous, sunny day LAST SUMMER, Claire and
her friend Greg went to LONGLEAT SAFARI PARK.'
'take place' = sodir bo'lmoq;  take → TOOK (noto'g'ri fe'l).
tasks.speak: 1  Where and when did the story take place?

tasks.whyUz:
Matnda: 'One GORGEOUS, SUNNY day'.
SAVOL QOLIPI: 'What was the weather LIKE?'
= Ob-havo qanday edi? ('like' javobda takrorlanmaydi).

tasks.prompt: 3  Who are the two main characters in the story?
tasks.answer: The two main characters are Claire and her friend Greg.
tasks.whyUz:
'a main character' = bosh qahramon.
Uchinchi shaxs — park ranger — asosiy qahramon emas,
u faqat oxirida paydo bo'ladi.
tasks.speak: 3  Who are the two main characters in the story?

tasks.prompt: 4  What happened to Claire and Greg?
tasks.answer: Their car caught fire in the safari park and they couldn't get out because the lions were around it.
tasks.whyUz:
Matnda: 'the front of the car was ON FIRE. They wanted to
jump out of the car, BUT THEY COULDN'T BECAUSE THE LIONS
WERE AROUND IT.'
Ikki muammo birga: yong'in VA sherlar.
tasks.speak: 4  What happened to Claire and Greg?

tasks.answer: A park ranger saved them. He came along the road in his jeep and another jeep chased away the lions.
tasks.whyUz:
Matnda: 'a park ranger came along the road in his jeep'
va 'another jeep arrived and chased away the lions'.
'to save' = qutqarmoq.

tasks.prompt: 6  How did Claire and Greg feel at the end of the story?
tasks.answer: They were still shocked, but happy. They knew they were very lucky to be alive.
tasks.whyUz:
Matnda: 'They were still SHOCKED, but HAPPY. They knew
they were very LUCKY to be alive.'
76-betdagi 1-mashqning 7-savoli ham shu haqda.
tasks.speak: 6  How did Claire and Greg feel at the end of the story?

tasks.prompt: 7  What is the main event of the story?
tasks.answer: The main event is that the car caught fire while the lions were around it, so Claire and Greg were trapped inside.
tasks.promptUz: Hikoyaning eng muhim, eng keskin joyi
tasks.whyUz:
'the main event' = asosiy voqea — hikoyaning eng keskin
nuqtasi.
Bu yerda: mashina yonyapti, LEKIN sherlar tufayli
chiqib bo'lmaydi.
Agar faqat yong'in bo'lsa, chiqib ketardilar —
ikki xavf BIRGA bo'lgani uchun vaziyat keskin.
tasks.speak: 7  What is the main event of the story?

exercises.instructionEn: We use first, then, after that, just then, next, finally, etc to talk about events which happened one after the other.
exercises.instructionUz: Ketma-ket sodir bo'lgan voqealar haqida gapirish uchun first, then, after that, just then, next, finally kabi so'zlarni ishlatamiz.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI QOIDA:
  first, then, after that, just then, next, finally va h.k.
  so'zlarini BIRIN-KETIN sodir bo'lgan voqealar haqida
  gapirish uchun ishlatamiz.

KITOBDAGI MISOL:
  Tony decided to go on a picnic. FIRST, he made some
  sandwiches, THEN he packed the picnic basket. ...

OLTI SO'Z VA ULARNING O'RNI:

  FIRST      — BIRINCHI voqea
               First, they drove into the park.

  THEN       — keyingi voqea
               Then he stopped the car.

  AFTER THAT — shundan keyin
               After that, he tried to start the car.

  NEXT       — keyin (= then)
               Next, smoke came out of the engine.

  JUST THEN  — AYNAN shu payt (KUTILMAGANDA)
               Just then, a park ranger came along.

  FINALLY    — NIHOYAT, eng oxirgi voqea
               Finally, another jeep chased the lions away.

DIQQAT — VERGUL:
  Gap boshida kelsa, keyin VERGUL qo'yiladi:
     FIRST, they drove into the park.
     JUST THEN, a park ranger came along.
  'then' esa vergulsiz ham kelishi mumkin:
     Then he stopped the car.

DIQQAT — 'JUST THEN' ning ALOHIDA ma'nosi:
  Boshqalari shunchaki ketma-ketlikni bildiradi,
  'just then' esa KUTILMAGAN, to'satdan bo'lgan
  voqeani ta'kidlaydi.
  Hikoyada aynan qutqaruv kelganda ishlatilgan.

BOSHQA FOYDALI SO'ZLAR (hikoyadan):
  suddenly            = to'satdan
  soon                = tez orada
  a few minutes later = bir necha daqiqadan keyin
  almost immediately  = deyarli darhol
  when                = ...ganda
  in the end          = oxir-oqibat

tasks.en: We use first, then, after that, just then, next, finally, etc to talk about events which happened one after the other.
tasks.uz: Ketma-ket sodir bo'lgan voqealar haqida gapirish uchun first, then, after that, just then, next, finally kabi so'zlarni ishlatamiz.

tasks.en: We use first, then, after that, just then, next, finally, etc to talk about events which happened one after the other.
tasks.uz: Birin-ketin sodir bo'lgan voqealar haqida gapirish uchun bu so'zlarni ishlatamiz.
tasks.note:
KITOBDAGI QOIDA.
'one after the other' = birin-ketin.

tasks.en: Tony decided to go on a picnic. First, he made some sandwiches, then he packed the picnic basket.
tasks.uz: Toni piknikka borishga qaror qildi. Avval buterbrod tayyorladi, so'ng piknik savatini yig'di.
tasks.note:
KITOBDAGI MISOL.
'FIRST' — birinchi ish;  'THEN' — keyingi ish.
'a picnic basket' = piknik savati.

tasks.en: first
tasks.uz: avval, birinchi
tasks.note:
ENG BIRINCHI voqea.
Gap boshida, keyin VERGUL.

tasks.en: then
tasks.uz: so'ng, keyin
tasks.note:
Keyingi voqea.
Vergulsiz ham kelishi mumkin.

tasks.en: after that
tasks.uz: shundan keyin
tasks.note: 'then' bilan bir xil ma'no, biroz rasmiyroq.

tasks.en: next
tasks.uz: keyin
tasks.note: 'then' bilan bir xil ma'no.

tasks.en: just then
tasks.uz: shu payt, aynan o'shanda
tasks.note:
KUTILMAGAN voqea uchun.
Hikoyada qutqaruv kelganda ishlatilgan:
'JUST THEN, a park ranger came along the road.'

tasks.en: finally
tasks.uz: nihoyat
tasks.note:
ENG OXIRGI voqea.
'at last' ham shu ma'noda.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the summary of the story and underline the correct words in bold.
exercises.instructionUz: Hikoya xulosasini o'qing va qalin yozilgan to'g'ri so'zlarning tagiga chizing.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ XULOSA (to'ldirilgan holda):

  Greg and Claire decided to go to Longleat Safari Park.
  FIRST, they drove into the park and Greg stopped the car.
  He took some pictures of the lions. AFTER THAT, he tried
  to start the car again. Suddenly, smoke began to come out
  of the engine. A few minutes later, the front of the car
  was on fire, so Claire beeped the horn and shouted for
  help. JUST THEN, a park ranger came along in his jeep to
  help them. FINALLY, another jeep arrived and chased the
  lions away. Greg and Claire felt very lucky to be alive.


O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  Greg va Kler Longleat safari parkiga borishga qaror
  qilishdi. Avval ular parkka haydab kirishdi va Greg
  mashinani to'xtatdi. U sherlarni suratga oldi. Shundan
  keyin mashinani qaytadan yurgizmoqchi bo'ldi. To'satdan
  dvigateldan tutun chiqa boshladi. Bir necha daqiqadan
  keyin mashinaning old qismi yona boshladi, shuning uchun
  Kler signal chaldi va yordam so'rab qichqirdi. Shu payt
  jipda park qo'riqchisi ularga yordamga keldi. Nihoyat,
  yana bir jip yetib keldi va sherlarni quvib yubordi.
  Greg va Kler tirik qolganlari uchun juda omadli
  ekanlarini his qilishdi.

tasks.prompt: 1  First / Next, they drove into the park and Greg stopped the car.
tasks.whyUz:
Bu — xulosaning BIRINCHI voqeasi → FIRST.
'Next' oldingi voqeadan keyin kelganda ishlatiladi,
lekin bu yerda oldin hech narsa bo'lmagan
(faqat qaror qabul qilingan).

tasks.prompt: 2  Finally / After that, he tried to start the car again.
tasks.whyUz:
Hikoya HALI DAVOM ETADI → AFTER THAT.
'Finally' faqat ENG OXIRGI voqea uchun —
bu yerda hali yong'in, qutqaruv voqealari bor.

tasks.prompt: 3  When / Just then, a park ranger came along in his jeep to help them.
tasks.whyUz:
'JUST THEN' — kutilmagan voqea uchun RAVISH,
gap boshida mustaqil turadi.
'When' esa BOG'LOVChI — undan keyin ERGASH GAP kerak:
  'WHEN they were safe, they thanked him.'  ✓
  'WHEN, a park ranger came ...'            ✗ XATO
77-betdagi hikoyada ham aynan 'Just then' ishlatilgan.

tasks.prompt: 4  Finally / Last, another jeep arrived and chased the lions away.
tasks.whyUz:
'FINALLY' — eng oxirgi voqea uchun standart RAVISH.
'Last' — SIFAT yoki ravish, lekin gap boshida
voqealar ketma-ketligida ishlatilmaydi.
'At last' esa to'g'ri bo'lardi.

exercises.instructionEn: Then, look at the pictures on p. 76 and give a summary of the story. Use first, then, after that, etc where necessary.
exercises.instructionUz: So'ng 76-betdagi rasmlarga qarang va hikoya xulosasini so'zlab bering. Kerak bo'lganda first, then, after that kabi so'zlardan foydalaning.
exercises.explanationUz:
76-BETDAGI OLTI RASM BO'YICHA:

  A → sherlar orasidagi mashina
  B → dvigateldan tutun
  C → mashinaning oldi yonyapti
  D → mashina yonmoqda, sherlar atrofda
  E → jipga yugurish
  F → qutulish, xursandchilik

QOLIP:
  [ketma-ketlik so'zi], + [ega] + [o'tgan zamon fe'li] + ...

TO'LIQ NAMUNA (rasmlar bo'yicha):

  Last summer, Claire and Greg went to Longleat Safari
  Park. FIRST, they drove into the park and closed the car
  windows tightly. THEN, Greg stopped the car near some
  lions and took pictures of them. The lions roared loudly.
  AFTER THAT, Greg tried to start the car, but nothing
  happened. Smoke began to come out of the engine. A FEW
  MINUTES LATER, the front of the car was on fire. They
  couldn't get out because the lions were around the car.
  Claire beeped the horn and shouted for help. JUST THEN, a
  park ranger came along the road in his jeep. FINALLY,
  another jeep chased the lions away and Claire and Greg
  ran towards the jeep. IN THE END, they were safe. They
  were shocked but happy, and very lucky to be alive.


O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  O'tgan yozda Kler va Greg Longleat safari parkiga
  borishdi. Avval ular parkka haydab kirishdi va mashina
  oynalarini mahkam yopishdi. So'ng Greg mashinani
  sherlarga yaqin to'xtatdi va ularni suratga oldi.
  Sherlar baland ovozda bo'kirishdi. Shundan keyin Greg
  mashinani yurgizmoqchi bo'ldi, lekin hech narsa bo'lmadi.
  Dvigateldan tutun chiqa boshladi. Bir necha daqiqadan
  keyin mashinaning old qismi yona boshladi. Ular chiqa
  olmadilar, chunki sherlar mashina atrofida edi. Kler
  signal chaldi va yordam so'rab qichqirdi. Shu payt yo'l
  bo'ylab jipda park qo'riqchisi keldi. Nihoyat, yana bir
  jip sherlarni quvib yubordi va Kler bilan Greg jip tomon
  yugurishdi. Oxir-oqibat ular xavfsiz bo'lishdi. Sarosimada,
  lekin xursand edilar va tirik qolganlari uchun juda
  omadli edilar.

tasks.answer: Last summer, Claire and Greg went to Longleat Safari Park.
First, they drove into the park and closed the car windows tightly. Then, Greg stopped the car near some lions and took pictures of them.
After that, Greg tried to start the car, but nothing happened. Smoke began to come out of the engine.

tasks.prompt: C va D-rasm: yong'in va sherlar
tasks.answer: A few minutes later, the front of the car was on fire. They couldn't get out because the lions were around the car.
tasks.speak: C va D-rasm: yong'in va sherlar

tasks.answer: Claire beeped the horn and shouted for help. Just then, a park ranger came along the road in his jeep.
Finally, another jeep chased the lions away and Claire and Greg ran towards the jeep. In the end, they were safe. They were shocked but happy, and very lucky to be alive.
